issues.summary: Q-45 · Emerging issues #sec-emerging: rising topics, 8-week sparkline, sentiment, quote
issues.description:
*Module:* APP · *Layer:* ui · *Repo:* HumanifyOS-UI

*UI screen:* [/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/quality-hub.html|/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/quality-hub.html] (routes /voc#sec-emerging, → /drill/vol/topic/<name>)

h3. Why
Emerging issues (video 04:13–04:24) are the topics rising fastest week over week weighted by worsening sentiment: a {{3 rising}} pill, one card per topic with its delta, 8-week area chart, sentiment bar, contacts/CSAT/negative share and a representative negative quote. The section re-scopes by program and period, updates when the emerging job publishes {{hos.voc.emerging.v1}}, and must render an honest empty state per scope.

h3. What
*UI screen:* {{/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/shots/cx-emerging.png}} · {{/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/quality-hub.html}} (open the .html mock in a browser; shots are the rendered baseline)

Deliver {{apps/web/quality/src/modules/voc/emerging/}} + {{src/api/app-voc-emerging.ts}}: {{useEmerging(period, program)}} key {{['app','voc','emerging',period,program]}} → {{vocEmerging}} ({{EmergingTopic(id, name, delta, trend, sent, vol, csat, neg, quote)[]}}; first paint from {{VocOverview.emerging}}); {{EmergingSection}} ({{#sec-emerging}}: title {{Emerging issues & trends}}, pill {{<n> rising}}, copy {{Topics rising fastest week-over-week, weighted by worsening sentiment · <scope_note>.}}, {{EmergingCard}}: name · {{+<delta>%}} chip · Q-16 {{TrendArea trend}} (8 weeks, compact) · {{SentimentStack sent}} · {{<vol> contacts · CSAT <csat> · <neg>% negative}} · the representative negative {{quote}} as text; card click → {{/drill/vol/topic/<name>}} (Q-38); empty {{No emerging issues in <program_name> for <period label>.}}); frame {{hos.voc.emerging.v1}} → invalidate (Q-62); period + program from Q-40; mobile: cards stack one per row; {{README.md}}; vitest + axe.

h3. Acceptance criteria
* *AC-1* (happy): Given {{/voc?period=week&program=all}} ({{fixtures/data/cx_emerging.json}}), then the pill reads {{3 rising}} and the first card {{Claim status / delay · +38%}} with an 8-week sparkline, the sentiment bar, {{3,120 contacts · CSAT 3.2 · 56% negative}} and a negative quote; clicking it navigates to {{/drill/vol/topic/Claim%20status%20%2F%20delay?period=week&program=all}}.
* *AC-2* (edge): Given {{?program=property&period=30d}} with no rising topic, then the copy {{No emerging issues in Property for Last 30 days.}}; given a frame {{hos.voc.emerging.v1}}, the list refetches and a new card appears without reload; given {{trend=[]}} on a card, the sparkline shows {{No data}} and the card still renders.
* *AC-3* (negative): Given Ramona's session, then the section never mounts; given {{vocEmerging}} answering {{503 (code:"upstream_unavailable")}}, the section shows the overview's {{emerging}} list with a {{Live update unavailable}} note and no retry storm (one retry).
* *AC-4* (happy): Given the axe sweep on the section with three cards, then zero violations: each sparkline has {{role=img}} with {{aria-label}} {{<name>, 8 weeks, +38%}} and the quote is a {{<blockquote>}}.
* *AC-5* (happy): Given the screen rendered at 1440×900 against the msw data, then the emerging section matches (pill, copy, three cards with delta chips, sparklines, sentiment bars, stats and quotes) and the render matches {{/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/shots/cx-emerging.png}} within the ≤ 5 % perceptual-diff tolerance X-10 uses (fonts / anti-aliasing, Q-8); every string of the DOM dump {{/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/shots/text/cx-emerging.txt}} that belongs to this ticket's elements is present in the DOM.
* *AC-6* (happy): Test command: {{pnpm --filter quality test -- voc/emerging}} exits 0 — vitest + testing-library against the Q-60 msw handlers generated from {{fixtures/data}} (the UI's local data mode): no BFF process, no browser, no Playwright.

h3. Technical details
* *Lock units:* {{apps/web/quality/src/modules/voc/emerging}}, {{apps/web/quality/src/api/app-voc-emerging.ts}}
* *API contract:* GET /v1/app/cx/emerging (vocEmerging), GET /v1/app/cx/overview (vocOverview)
* *Migration:* none
* *Idempotency:* n/a (read-only or naturally idempotent)
* *Config keys:* —
* *Vendors:* TanStack Query, d3-scale
* *Implementer notes:* The emerging rule (WoW delta weighted by sentiment shift) runs server-side ({{cx_emerging.json}} rule + lists per period × program; the ops route {{POST /v1/_ops/emerging/run}} triggers it in live mode); the UI never ranks. Quotes are anonymized server text rendered as text. The sparkline is Q-16's {{TrendArea}} in compact mode (no axis labels).

*Blocked by:* Q-00, Q-02, Q-04, Q-61, Q-16, A-53
